plain: The rank of a noble, or all the nobles of a country as a group

webster.text: The rank or dignity of a peer or nobleman.

example.quote: besides which, I stand here, with my very honorable colleagues, as a representative of the citizens of this great metropolis, who have been pleased to honor me with their confidence — an honor, in my view, unspeakably greater than a peerage or a pension.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Massachusetts Convention, Rev. Mr. STILLMAN, February 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
